# Why I’m Running
### A Commitment to Cambrian Students, Families, and Our Community
I am proud to be a candidate for the Cambrian School District Board of Trustees. Cambrian is not simply a school district to me—it is the community where I raised my two sons and where my family has deep roots. My children attended Bagby and Price before going on to Branham High School, and I have personally experienced the tremendous impact Cambrian schools can have on students and families.
My connection to Cambrian goes back even further. I began my teaching career at Ida Price Middle School, where I taught for eight years and developed a deep appreciation for the students, families, and educators who make this community special. It was also at Price that I met my husband, John Olsen, who has continued to teach there for over 30 years. Cambrian has truly been an important part of our family’s life.
Professionally, I bring more than 30 years of experience in public education, serving as a teacher, site administrator, district administrator, and county office administrator. I have led schools and programs, managed budgets and personnel, supported curriculum and instruction, and opened a brand-new school as its founding principal. These experiences have given me a comprehensive understanding of how schools and districts operate and, most importantly, how thoughtful and effective leadership can positively impact student success.
I am a strong and passionate advocate for public education. I believe our community deserves schools that are academically excellent, financially responsible, and committed to the success of every child. As a trustee, I would work to maintain the district's financial stability while also prioritizing the recruitment, hiring, and retention of outstanding teachers and staff. I believe educators deserve meaningful professional learning and strong support so they can do what they do best: help students learn and thrive.
I also believe that our classified employees are at the heart of our schools. From instructional aides and office staff to custodians, maintenance professionals, and other essential team members, classified staff play an indispensable role in creating safe, welcoming, and effective schools. I will work to ensure their voices and needs are represented alongside those of our certificated staff.
Student achievement matters deeply to me, and I want Cambrian students to continue to excel academically. At the same time, we must recognize that academic success is closely connected to student wellness. I am committed to supporting the whole child through strong counseling programs, wellness centers, social-emotional learning, and other supports that help students feel safe, connected, and ready to learn.
I am also a strong believer in inclusive and welcoming schools where every student and family is treated with dignity and respect. I support efforts to prevent discrimination and bullying and believe our schools should be places where all students feel safe, valued, and supported. Every child deserves the opportunity to be exactly who they are and to know that they belong in their school community.
As a parent, educator, and longtime member of the Cambrian community, I care deeply about the future of this district. I understand the challenges facing public education, but I also know the tremendous strengths we have to build upon.
If elected, I will bring experience, integrity, fiscal responsibility, and a collaborative approach to the Board. I will listen to families, educators, classified staff, students, and community members; make decisions based on what is best for students; and work to preserve Cambrian's tradition of excellence while thoughtfully preparing for the future.
Cambrian has been an important part of my family's story for decades. I would be honored to give back to the community that has given our family—and so many others—so much.

Barrie London
Retired Teacher, Bagby Elementary School, Cambrian School District
As a teacher and education administrator for the past 33 years, and a resident of the Cambrian School District for 31 years, I am pleased to endorse Debora Bodenheimer as a board member. I have known Ms. Bodenheimer to be a talented, experienced, caring and very capable educator. She has served a number of roles over her educational career, such as teacher, assistant principal and principal. She is also widely experienced at the district and county level. Throughout those experiences Ms. Bodenheimer has always worked to keep students and their needs her focus. She has a keen grasp of how school districts operate, develop plans and policies, and has worked diligently to serve students and their communities with intellect and heart. I can think of no better person for this position.
Michael Posey
Social Studies Teacher, Leigh High School, Former Principal, Westmont High School
I am proud to endorse Debi Bodenheimer for Cambrian School District School Board. I have known Debi for over 30 years. We team-taught together for three years, and I also had the privilege of teaching both of her sons.
Debi is meticulous, organized, thorough, and truly cares about students and families. She taught at Price for eight years and has experience as an administrator at the site, district, and county office levels. Having lived in Cambrian for 25 years and raised her family here, she knows our community and our schools well. Her experience as a teacher, parent, and administrator gives her a valuable perspective on the needs of students, families, and staff.
After 35 years of teaching in Cambrian, including five years as president of our teachers’ union, I have had the opportunity to work closely with parents, administrators, and board members. I believe Debi’s experience, knowledge of our district, and understanding of these different perspectives would make her a very valuable addition to our School Board.
